title: The ALMOND survey: molecular cloud properties and gas density tracers across 25 nearby spiral galaxies with ALMA
question: Characterise the impact of cloud-scale structural and dynamical molecular gas properties (surface density, velocity dispersion, virial parameter, internal turbulent pressure) on the kpc-scale dense gas fraction (traced by HCN/CO) and dense gas star formation efficiency (traced by SFR/HCN) across 25 nearby spiral galaxies.

data.arrays: ALMOND: ACA (7-m array + 12-m TP); PHANGS-ALMA: 12-m array + ACA (7-m + TP)
data.sensitivity: ALMOND: ~1 mK per 10 km s^-1 channel (NGC 2903, NGC 4321), ~3 mK (other 23 galaxies); PHANGS-ALMA: 0.2-0.3 K per 2.5 km s^-1 channel

what.value: PHANGS-ALMA CO(2-1) line cubes and integrated galaxy properties (stellar mass, H2 mass, global SFR)

evidence.quote: Integrated galaxy properties (6-8) are taken from (cite: Leroy2021b).
We trace the bulk molecular gas via the $\text{CO(2--1)}$ emission line as observed by the PHANGS–ALMA survey (cite: Leroy2021b).

what.value: Star formation rate maps at 15" resolution from z0MGS (WISE4 + GALEX-FUV)

evidence.quote: We use star formation rate maps from the "z = 0 Multiwavelength Galaxy Synthesis" study (z0MGS; (cite: Leroy2019)) adopting a combination of 22 $\mu$ m (WISE4) and GALEX-FUV 154 nm emission.
We downloaded the SFR maps for our galaxy sample at a resolution of 15″ from the public z0MGS repository
Columns (10) and (11) specify if a galaxy is barred (Y) or unbarred (N) (cite: Querejeta2021b)
and if it contains an AGN (Y) or not (N) (cite: Veron2010).

recipe.goal: Homogenise spatial resolution, sample on hexagonal grids, and create 3D CO-based masks and integrated intensity maps
recipe.method: Convolve CO(2-1) cubes to cloud-scale resolution (150 pc, and 120 pc / 75 pc for sub-samples) and CO(2-1), HCN(1-0), HCO+(1-0), CS(2-1) cubes and SFR maps to kpc-scale resolution (2.1 kpc, and 1.5 kpc / 1.0 kpc for sub-samples). Resample onto hexagonal grids (2 samples per beam FWHM at cloud scale, 1 sample per beam FWHM at kpc scale). Build 3D PPV masks from CO(2-1) by finding cores with S/N >= 4 in >= 3 adjacent channels and iteratively growing into regions with S/N >= 2 in >= 3 adjacent channels. Collapse masked cubes along velocity axis to get integrated intensities and compute uncertainties from emission-free channel rms.
key_parameters: High S/N mask threshold: S/N >= 4 in >= 3 adjacent channels; Low S/N mask threshold: S/N >= 2 in >= 3 adjacent channels
Target resolutions: 150 pc (cloud-scale) and 2.1 kpc (kpc-scale) for full sample; 120 pc / 1.5 kpc and 75 pc / 1.0 kpc for sub-samples
assumptions: CO(2-1) emission regions encompass the regions of dense gas tracer (HCN, HCO+, CS) emission

recipe.goal: Compute kpc-scale dense gas ratios (HCN/CO, SFR/HCN, HCO+/CO, SFR/HCO+, CS/CO, SFR/CS) and physical proxies (f_dense, SFE_dense)
recipe.method: Take ratios of kpc-scale integrated intensities W_HCN / W_CO(2-1) and Sigma_SFR / W_HCN (and analogously for HCO+ and CS). Convert to f_dense and SFE_dense using constant conversion factors.
assumptions: alpha_CO = 4.3 M_sun pc^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1, R_21 = 0.64, alpha_HCN = 14 M_sun pc^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1

recipe.goal: Derive cloud-scale molecular gas properties (Sigma_mol, sigma_mol, alpha_vir, P_turb) at 150 pc resolution
recipe.method: Compute pixel-by-pixel Sigma_mol from W_CO(2-1), sigma_mol from the Heyer (2001) effective line width deconvolved for instrumental response, alpha_vir from sigma_mol^2 / Sigma_mol, and P_turb from Sigma_mol * sigma_mol^2.
key_parameters: D_beam = 150 pc (and 120 pc, 75 pc for sub-samples)
assumptions: Constant alpha_CO = 4.3 M_sun pc^-2 (K km s^-1)^-1 and R_21 = 0.64; spherical clouds with radius R = D_beam / 2 and density profile rho propto r^-1 (f = 10/9)

recipe.goal: Compute CO intensity-weighted averages of cloud-scale properties at kpc scale
recipe.method: Multiply each cloud-scale map X by W_CO(2-1), convolve with a Gaussian kernel Omega to the kpc-scale resolution (2.1 kpc), and divide by the convolved W_CO(2-1) map. Resample to 1 sample per kpc-scale beam FWHM. Estimate uncertainties via 100 Monte Carlo realisations adding Gaussian noise.
key_parameters: 100 Monte Carlo iterations for uncertainty estimation; Gaussian convolution kernel to 2.1 kpc

recipe.goal: Bin kpc-scale data by <Sigma_mol> and perform Bayesian linear regression and correlation analysis
recipe.method: Bin each galaxy's data into 20 equally spaced bins in <Sigma_mol> (18 bins for discs-only when separating centres). Compute bin ratios as mean(numerator)/mean(denominator). Define 3-sigma upper limits for HCN/CO and lower limits for SFR/HCN when S/N < 3. Fit log-log linear relations using Bayesian MCMC linear regression in LinMix accounting for heteroscedastic errors on both axes, intrinsic scatter, and censored data.
key_parameters: 20 bins per galaxy (18 bins for discs only); S/N >= 3 detection threshold; x_off = {2.5, 1.1, 6.5} for {Sigma_mol, sigma_mol, P_turb}; >= 10000 MCMC steps after convergence
assumptions: Covariance between x- and y-axis uncertainties is negligible because HCN/CO uncertainties are dominated by HCN measurement uncertainties

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and PHANGS-ALMA pipeline version used for ALMOND data reduction
Exact imaging parameters for ALMOND ACA + TP cubes (tclean weighting/robust, cell size, image size, feather/tp2vis combination settings, continuum subtraction channels)
Exact rest frequencies and spectral window configurations for the ALMOND observations
Galaxy-specific log10(C_WISE4) and log10(C_FUV) coefficients used in the z0MGS SFR maps
Channel-to-channel correlation coefficient values used to compute sigma_response for line width deconvolution
missing_for_reproduction: Processed ALMOND 7m+TP data cubes (stated as available on request rather than in a public repository, though raw ALMA data are in the ALMA archive)
Custom scripts used for 3D CO-based PPV masking, hexagonal grid resampling, and intensity-weighted convolution averaging
Exact galaxy-by-galaxy log10(C_WISE4) and log10(C_FUV) values used to construct the z0MGS SFR maps
Channel-to-channel correlation coefficient used in instrumental line width deconvolution
score_reason: All 14 ALMA project codes and all 25 targets are explicitly listed, external datasets (PHANGS-ALMA, z0MGS) are public, and the mathematical equations for every derived quantity, binning scheme, and Bayesian regression (LinMix) are thoroughly specified. However, the reduced ALMOND cubes and custom masking/resampling scripts are not publicly hosted, and raw-to-cube imaging parameters are delegated to the PHANGS-ALMA pipeline paper.
rediscovery_reason: All raw ALMA project codes are listed and public in the ALMA archive, PHANGS-ALMA CO(2-1) cubes and z0MGS SFR maps are publicly released, the post-processing equations and binning/fitting steps are explicitly given, and the main results are precise numeric regression slopes and correlation coefficients.
